widgets.author: kingdompaulo
widgets.name: ai stars
widgets.description: The AI repos gaining GitHub stars fastest: stars per hour or day, % growth and acceleration, with a full ranking, language filter, search, pins and #1 alerts.
commands:
set -u
D="$HOME/.cache/ai-stars"; mkdir -p "$D"
ST="$D/state.json"; OUT="$D/top.json"
now=$(date +%s)
exec 9>"$D/.lock"
flock -w 50 9 || { cat "$OUT" 2>/dev/null || echo null; exit 0; }
last=$(jq -r '.updated // 0' "$OUT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ $((now - last)) -lt 200 ]; then cat "$OUT"; exit 0; fi
A=(-H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
new=$(date -u -d '45 days ago' +%F)
# Established projects by topic, plus young ones by keyword, so fresh risers show up early.
# One request at a time: GitHub turns away bursts of searches.
i=0
for q in "topic:llm stars:>500" "topic:ai stars:>500" "topic:ai-agents stars:>300" "topic:generative-ai stars:>500" \
  "topic:machine-learning stars:>1000" "topic:rag stars:>300" \
  "llm in:name,description,topics created:>$new stars:>100" "agent in:name,description,topics created:>$new stars:>100"; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  curl -s --max-time 10 "${A[@]}" --get --data-urlencode "q=$q" -d sort=stars -d order=desc -d per_page=100 \
    -o "$T/$i.json" -w '%{http_code}' https://api.github.com/search/repositories > "$T/$i.code"
done
for n in $(seq "$i"); do [ -f "$T/$n.json" ] || echo "{}" > "$T/$n.json"; done
ok=0; err=""
for f in "$T"/[0-9]*.json; do
  c=$(cat "${f%.json}.code")
  if [ "$c" = 200 ] && jq -e '.items | type == "array"' "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    jq '.items' "$f" > "$f.i" && mv "$f.i" "$f"; ok=$((ok + 1))
  else
    case "$c" in 403|429) err="rate limited by GitHub";; 000) err="offline";; *) err="GitHub error $c";; esac
    echo '[]' > "$f"
  fi
done
if [ "$ok" = 0 ]; then
  jq -c --arg e "$err" '. + {error: $e}' "$OUT" 2>/dev/null || jq -nc --arg e "$err" '{error: $e, top: []}'
  exit 0
fi
[ "$ok" -lt "$i" ] || err=""
jq -s 'add | unique_by(.full_name) | map({name: .full_name, url: .html_url, desc: ((.description // "") | .[0:120]), lang: (.language // ""), stars: .stargazers_count, created: .created_at})' "$T"/[0-9]*.json > "$T/docs.json"
[ -f "$ST" ] || echo '{}' > "$ST"
jq -c -n --argjson now "$now" --arg err "$err" --slurpfile d "$T/docs.json" --slurpfile s "$ST" '
  ($s[0] // {}) as $st | (if ($st.v // 0) >= 3 then $st else {repos: ($st.repos // {}), runs: ($st.runs // 0)} end) as $st |
  ($st.repos // {}) as $old |
  # Stars at time t from a [[t, stars]] history: the last point at or before t.
  def at($h; $t): [$h[] | select(.[0] <= $t)] | last;
  # Growth over the last w seconds, scaled to w when the nearest snapshot is a bit older.
  def grow($h; $s; $w): at($h; $now - $w) as $q |
    if $q == null or ($now - $q[0]) > $w * 1.5 then null else (($s - $q[1]) * $w / ($now - $q[0]) | round) end;
  def pct($g; $s): if $g == null or $s - $g <= 0 then null else $g / ($s - $g) * 100 end;
  ($d[0] | map({(.name): .}) | add) as $cur |
  # The market: stars gained per hour by repos present in both this and the last run.
  ([$cur | to_entries[] | select($old[.key].hist != null) | .value.stars - $old[.key].hist[-1][1]] | add // 0) as $delta |
  (($now - ($st.updated // $now)) / 3600) as $dh |
  (($old + ($cur | with_entries(
    .key as $k | ($old[$k] // {}) as $o | ($o.hist // []) as $h0 |
    .value += {
      hist: ((($h0 | map(select(.[0] > $now - 3 * 86400))) + [[$now, .value.stars]]) | sort_by(.[0]) | .[-300:]),
      seen: $now
    }))) | with_entries(select($now - .value.seen < 3 * 86400))) as $repos |
  ([$repos[] | select($now - .seen < 1800) | .hist as $h | (.stars - $h[0][1]) as $since | ($now - $h[0][0]) as $tf |
    (grow($h; .stars; 3600)) as $g1 | (grow($h; .stars; 21600)) as $g6 | (grow($h; .stars; 86400)) as $g24 |
    ((try (.created | fromdateiso8601) catch null) as $c | if $c then ($now - $c) / 86400 | floor else null end) as $age |
    {name, url, desc, lang, stars, age: $age,
     g1h: $g1, g6h: $g6, g24h: $g24, p1h: pct($g1; .stars), p6h: pct($g6; .stars), p24h: pct($g24; .stars),
     accel: (if $g6 != null and $g24 != null then $g6 / 6 - $g24 / 24 else null end),
     # Best guess at stars per day: the full day, else the last 6 hours, else what we have seen so far.
     rate: ($g24 // (if $g6 != null then $g6 * 4 else null end) // (if $tf >= 1800 then $since * 86400 / $tf else null end)),
     spark: (.hist | map(select(.[0] > $now - 86400)) | map(.[1]) | .[-16:])}]) as $e |
  (($st.agg // []) + (if $dh > 0 and $dh < 3 then [[$now, ($delta / $dh | round)]] else [] end) | .[-96:]) as $agg |
  {
    state: {v: 3, runs: (($st.runs // 0) + 1), updated: $now, agg: $agg,
            repos: $repos},
    out: {updated: $now, runs: (($st.runs // 0) + 1), error: (if $err == "" then null else $err end),
          tracked: ($e | length), warming: ($e | all(.g24h == null)), span: ([$repos[].hist[0][0]] | $now - min),
          full24: ($e | map(select(.g24h != null)) | length), full1: ($e | map(select(.g1h != null)) | length),
          total24h: ($e | map(.rate // 0) | add | round), totalStars: ($e | map(.stars) | add),
          perHour: $agg, top: ($e | sort_by(-(.rate // 0))),
          langs: ($e | map(select(.lang != "")) | group_by(.lang) | map({lang: .[0].lang, count: length, rate: (map(.rate // 0) | add)}) | sort_by(-.rate) | .[0:8])}
  }' > "$T/r.json" || { cat "$OUT"; exit 0; }
jq -c '.state' "$T/r.json" > "$ST.tmp" && mv "$ST.tmp" "$ST"
jq -c '.out' "$T/r.json" > "$OUT.tmp" && mv "$OUT.tmp" "$OUT"
cat "$OUT"

widgets.author: cipriandrei10
widgets.name: claude top
widgets.description: htop for Claude Code: every running instance with its status, folder, window, CPU and memory. Tap for details, the last prompt and kill
commands:
pids=$(pgrep -x claude)
[ -n "$pids" ] || { echo '[]'; exit 0; }
t1=""; for p in $pids; do t1="$t1 $(awk '{print $14+$15}' /proc/$p/stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"; done
sleep 1
set -- $t1
hz=$(getconf CLK_TCK)
home=$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" | cut -d: -f6)
for p in $pids; do
  a=$1; shift
  b=$(awk '{print $14+$15}' /proc/$p/stat 2>/dev/null) || continue
  read rss et tty <<<"$(ps -o rss=,etimes=,tty= -p "$p")"
  where=""; q=$p
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
    q=$(awk '{print $4}' /proc/$q/stat 2>/dev/null)
    [ -n "$q" ] && [ "$q" -gt 1 ] || break
    c=$(tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$q/cmdline 2>/dev/null)
    case $c in foot*--app-id=*) where=${c#*--app-id=}; where=${where%% *}; break ;; esac
  done
  f=~/.claude/sessions/$p.json; [ -f "$f" ] || f=/dev/null
  sid=$(jq -r '.sessionId // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  last=""; [ -n "$sid" ] && last=$(tac ~/.claude/history.jsonl 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 -F "\"sessionId\":\"$sid\"" | jq -r '.display // empty' | head -c 200)
  jq -n -c --argjson pid "$p" --argjson cpu "$(( (b - a) * 100 / hz ))" --argjson rss "${rss:-0}" --argjson up "${et:-0}" \
    --arg home "$home" --arg tty "$tty" --arg where "$where" --arg last "$last" --arg cwd "$(readlink /proc/$p/cwd)" \
    --slurpfile s <(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || true) \
    '($s[0] // {}) as $s | {pid: $pid, cpu: $cpu, mem: ($rss * 1024), up: $up, tty: $tty, where: $where, last: $last,
      sid: ($s.sessionId // ""), name: ($s.name // "claude"), status: ($s.status // "unknown"), cwd: ($s.cwd // $cwd),
      dir: (($s.cwd // $cwd) as $c | if $home != "" and ($c == $home or ($c | startswith($home + "/"))) then "~" + $c[($home | length):] else $c end),
      version: ($s.version // ""), since: (($s.statusUpdatedAt // 0) / 1000 | floor), started: (($s.startedAt // 0) / 1000 | floor)}'
done | jq -s -c 'sort_by(-.started)'

def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    tmp = path.with_name(path.name + '.' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False))
    tmp.chmod(0o600)
    tmp.replace(path)


def read_json(path, default=None):
    try:

    except (OSError, ValueError):

def chinese(text):

def clean_text(text):
    # Spoken notes are in the language of the reply, or the wrong voice would be picked for it.
    notes = SPOKEN[spoken(text)]
    text = re.sub(r'```.*?```', notes[2], text, flags=re.S)
    text = re.sub(r'!?\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)', r'\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', notes[3], text)
    text = re.sub(r'(?m)^\s*(?:#{1,6}\s+|[-*+]\s+|\d+[.)]\s+|>\s*)', '', text)
    text = text.replace('`', '').replace('**', '').replace('__', '')
    return ''.join(c for c in text if c in '\n\t' or (ord(c) >= 32 and ord(c) != 127)).strip()


def summarize(text, limit=360):
    '''Extract sentences verbatim; retain an explicit failure/limitation if present.'''
    text = clean_text(text)
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in re.split(r'(?<=[。！？.!?])\s*|\n+', text) if s.strip()]
    selected = []
    important = re.compile(r'未完成|尚未|無法|不能|失敗|限制|需要你|待.*確認|未.*驗證|未.*測試|not tested|failed|unable|cannot|limitation', re.I)
    warning = next((s for s in sentences if important.search(s)), '')
    # Reserve room for a caveat even when it appears at the end of a long answer.
    budget = limit - min(len(warning), limit // 2) - (8 if warning else 0)
    used = 0
    for s in sentences:
        if s == warning:
            continue
        if used + len(s) > budget:
            if not selected:
                selected.append(s[:budget].rstrip() + '…')
            break
        selected.append(s)
        used += len(s) + 1
    if warning:
        selected.append(warning[:limit // 2])
    notes = SPOKEN[spoken(text)]
    return notes[0] + ' '.join(selected) + notes[1]


def completed_reply(event):
    '''Ignore commentary, tool output, subagent logs and aborted turns.'''
    if event.get('type') != 'event_msg':
        return None
    payload = event.get('payload', {})
    if payload.get('type') != 'task_complete':
        return None
    text = payload.get('last_agent_message')
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        return None
    return payload.get('turn_id') or payload.get('root_turn_id') or event.get('timestamp'), text

    if not re.fullmatch(r'%[0-9]+', pane_id):

        self.state.update(auto=self.config['auto'], mode=self.config['mode'], thread=self.config['thread'], engine=self.config['engine'], follow_latest=self.config['follow_latest'], source=self.config['source'], pause_minutes=self.config['pause_minutes'], source_name=self.state.get('source_name','Codex'))
        # The tiles redraw on every write, so write only what changed.
        if self.state != self.saved:
            atomic_json(CACHE / 'state.json', self.state)
            self.saved = dict(self.state)

    def bind(self, thread):
        path = find_session(thread)
        if path is None:
            raise ValueError('找不到指定會話')
        self.config['thread'] = str(uuid.UUID(thread))
        self.path = path
        # Seed replay, but never automatically speak historical answers on startup.
        self.pending = b''
        self.last_turn = None
        self.state.update(full='', summary='', last_turn='', reply_at=None, awaiting=False, status='已連接，等待回覆')
        with path.open('rb') as f:
            for line in f:
                try:
                    event = json.loads(line)
                    reply = completed_reply(event)
                    kind = event.get('payload', {}).get('type')
                    if kind == 'task_started':
                        self.state['awaiting'] = True
                    elif kind in ('task_complete', 'turn_aborted'):
                        self.state['awaiting'] = False
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if reply:
                    self.last_turn, full = reply
                    self.state.update(full=full, summary=summarize(full), last_turn=self.last_turn, reply_at=event.get('timestamp'))
            self.offset = f.tell()
        self.state['status'] = 'Codex 正在回覆…' if self.state['awaiting'] else ('已同步最近回覆' if self.state['full'] else '已連接，等待回覆')
        atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
        self.save()

    def poll(self):
        if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
            return self.poll_terminal()
        if not self.config['thread']:
            self.config['thread'] = latest_session()
        if time.monotonic() - self.checked_session >= RETRY:
            self.checked_session = time.monotonic()
            if self.config['follow_latest']:
                thread = latest_session()
                if thread != self.config['thread']:
                    self.stop()
                    self.bind(thread)
        if self.path is None:
            self.bind(self.config['thread'])
        size = self.path.stat().st_size
        if size == self.offset:
            return
        if size < self.offset:
            self.bind(self.config['thread'])
        with self.path.open('rb') as f:
            f.seek(self.offset)
            data = f.read(4 * 1024 * 1024)
            self.offset = f.tell()
        lines = (self.pending + data).split(b'\n')
        self.pending = lines.pop()
        for line in lines:
            try:
                event = json.loads(line)
                reply = completed_reply(event)
                kind = event.get('payload', {}).get('type')
                if kind == 'task_started':
                    self.state.update(awaiting=True, status='Codex 正在回覆…', error='')
                    self.save()
                elif kind in ('task_complete', 'turn_aborted'):
                    self.state['awaiting'] = False
            except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
                continue
            if not reply or reply[0] == self.last_turn:
                continue
            self.last_turn, full = reply
            self.state.update(full=full, summary=summarize(full), last_turn=self.last_turn,
                              status='收到新回覆', error='', awaiting=False, reply_at=event.get('timestamp'))
            self.save()
            if self.config['auto']:
                self.play(self.state[self.config['mode']])

    def poll_terminal(self):
        if time.monotonic() < self.next_terminal:
            return
        self.next_terminal = time.monotonic() + 3
        try:
            pane, label, full = terminal_snapshot()
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.next_terminal = time.monotonic() + RETRY
            self.state.update(source_name='Terminal', term_pane='', status=str(exc),
                              full='', summary='', error='', reply_at=None, awaiting=False)
            self.save()
            return
        self.state.update(source_name=label, term_pane=pane, status='已連接終端 · 點播放讀取畫面',
                          error='', awaiting=False)
        if full != self.term_last:
            self.term_last = full
            self.state.update(full=full, summary=clean_text(full)[-360:], reply_at=time.time() if full else None)
        self.save()

    def idle(self):
        '''Nothing is being spoken, and no tile, command or Codex activity for the chosen time.'''
        limit = self.config['pause_minutes'] * 60
        if not limit or self.state.get('playing'):
            return False
        # Codex still writing its log counts, so a long task is read aloud with the screen off.
        seen = [ALIVE] + ([self.path] if self.path and self.config['source'] == 'codex' else [])
        try:
            return time.time() - max(path.stat().st_mtime for path in seen) >= limit
        except OSError:
            return False

    def stop(self):
        with self.player_lock:
            self.generation += 1
            if self.process is not None:
                self.process.terminate()
                try:
                    self.process.wait(timeout=2)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    self.process.kill()
                    self.process.wait()
                self.process = None
            self.state.update(playing=False, status='已停止')
            self.save()

    def play(self, text):
        if not text.strip():
            raise ValueError('還沒有可播放的回覆')
        self.stop()
        with self.player_lock:
            generation = self.generation
            self.state.update(playing=True, status='正在播放', error='')
            self.save()

        def worker():
            wav = CACHE / ('speech-' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.wav')
            try:
                with self.player_lock:
                    if generation != self.generation:
                        return
                if not shutil.which('espeak-ng') or not shutil.which('paplay'):
                    raise ValueError('需要 espeak-ng 和 paplay')
                commands = [
                    ([str(Path(__file__).parent / 'venv/bin/python'),
                      str(Path(__file__).parent / 'synthesize.py'), str(wav)], clean_text(text).encode()),
                    (['paplay', str(wav)], None),
                ]
                for args, data in commands:
                    if data is None:
                        with self.player_lock:
                            if generation == self.generation:
                                backend = Path(str(wav) + '.backend')
                                self.state['status'] = '正在播放 · ' + (backend.read_text() if backend.exists() else '語音')
                                self.save()
                    with self.player_lock:
                        if generation != self.generation:
                            return
                        proc = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE if data else subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
                        self.process = proc
                    try:
                        _, err = proc.communicate(data, timeout=300)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        proc.kill()
                        proc.communicate()
                        raise ValueError('播放逾時')
                    if proc.returncode and generation == self.generation:
                        raise ValueError(err.decode(errors='replace')[-400:] or '播放失敗')
                with self.player_lock:
                    if generation == self.generation:
                        self.process = None
                        # Keep the reason on screen when the natural voice was not the one heard.
                        used = Path(str(wav) + '.backend')
                        used = used.read_text() if used.exists() else ''
                        self.state.update(playing=False, status='播放完成 · '+used if '離線' in used and '（' in used else '播放完成')
                        self.save()
            except Exception as exc:
                with self.player_lock:
                    if generation == self.generation:
                        self.state.update(playing=False, status='播放失敗', error=str(exc))
                        self.save()
            finally:
                wav.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                Path(str(wav) + '.backend').unlink(missing_ok=True)
        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    def command(self, request):
        action = request.get('action')
        if action != 'status':
            self.retry_at = 0
        if action in ('replay', 'send'):
            if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
                self.next_terminal = 0
            self.poll()
        if action == 'status':
            # Also how a change of interface language reaches the tiles: save() writes only what changed.
            self.save()
            return self.state
        if action == 'replay':
            self.play(self.state.get('full' if request.get('full') else 'summary', ''))
        elif action == 'test':
            self.play(SPOKEN[chosen()][4])
        elif action == 'stop':
            self.stop()
        elif action == 'auto':
            value = request.get('value', 'toggle')
            self.config['auto'] = not self.config['auto'] if value == 'toggle' else value == 'on'
            if not self.config['auto']:
                self.stop()
            self.state['status'] = '自動播報已開啟' if self.config['auto'] else '自動播報已關閉'
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.save()
        elif action == 'engine':
            value = request.get('value', 'toggle')
            if value == 'toggle':
                value = 'offline' if self.config['engine'] == 'online' else 'online'
            if value not in ('online', 'offline'):
                raise ValueError('請選 online 或 offline')
            self.stop()
            self.config['engine'] = value
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.state['status'] = '已切換線上自然語音' if value == 'online' else '已切換離線神經語音'
            self.save()
        elif action == 'pause':
            value = str(request.get('value', 'toggle')).strip().lower()
            if value == 'toggle':
                value = '0' if self.config['pause_minutes'] else str(PAUSE_MINUTES)
            if value == 'off':
                value = '0'
            if not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit() or int(value) > 1440:
                raise ValueError('請輸入 1 到 1440 的分鐘數，或 off')
            self.config['pause_minutes'] = int(value)
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.state['status'] = '已更新閒置暫停時間' if int(value) else '閒置後不再暫停'
            self.save()
        elif action == 'refresh':
            self.stop()
            if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
                self.next_terminal = 0
                self.poll_terminal()
            else:
                self.bind(latest_session() if self.config['follow_latest'] else self.config['thread'])
        elif action == 'source':
            value = request.get('value')
            if value not in ('codex', 'terminal'):
                raise ValueError('請選 Codex 或 Terminal')
            self.stop()
            self.config['source'] = value
            self.state.update(full='', summary='', reply_at=None, source_name='Codex' if value == 'codex' else 'Terminal')
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            if value == 'terminal':
                self.next_terminal = 0
                self.term_last = None
                self.poll_terminal()
            else:
                self.bind(latest_session() if self.config['follow_latest'] else self.config['thread'])
        elif action == 'follow':
            self.config['follow_latest'] = not self.config['follow_latest']
            if self.config['follow_latest']:
                self.stop()
                self.bind(latest_session())
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.save()
        elif action == 'bind':
            self.stop()
            self.config['follow_latest'] = False
            self.bind(request['thread'])
        elif action == 'send':
            text = request.get('text', '').strip()
            if not text or len(text) > 16000:
                raise ValueError('請先輸入內容（最多 16000 字）')
            if any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in '\n\t' for c in text):
                raise ValueError('文字含有控制字元')
            self.stop()
            if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
                pane, label, _ = terminal_snapshot()
                terminal_send(pane, text)
                self.state.update(status='已送到終端 · '+label, error='')
            else:
                result = subprocess.run(['codex', 'queue', '--thread', self.config['thread'], '--message', text],
                                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
                if result.returncode:
                    raise ValueError(result.stderr[-500:] or result.stdout[-500:] or '送出失敗')
                self.state.update(status='已送到這個 Codex 會話的佇列', error='')
            self.save()
        else:
            raise ValueError('未知命令')
        return {'ok': True, 'status': self.state['status']}


def serve():
    CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    with (CACHE / 'daemon.lock').open('w') as lock:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            return
        ALIVE.touch()
        reader = Reader()
        if reader.config['source'] == 'terminal':
            reader.poll_terminal()
        elif reader.config['thread']:
            reader.bind(reader.config['thread'])
        SOCKET.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as server:
            server.bind(str(SOCKET))
            SOCKET.chmod(0o600)
            server.listen(4)
            while not reader.idle():
                # The dictation page and the setup screen write the language without telling the service.
                if changed_at() != reader.language_at:
                    reader.save()
                if time.monotonic() >= reader.retry_at:
                    try:
                        reader.poll()
                    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
                        reader.state.update(status='等待會話記錄', error=str(exc))
                        reader.save()
                        reader.retry_at = time.monotonic() + RETRY
                if not select.select([server], [], [], 0.5)[0]:
                    continue
                conn, _ = server.accept()
                with conn:
                    conn.settimeout(5)
                    try:
                        data = b''
                        while b'\n' not in data and len(data) <= 70000:
                            part = conn.recv(8192)
                            if not part:
                                break
                            data += part
                        if len(data) > 70000:
                            raise ValueError('請求太大')
                        response = reader.command(json.loads(data))
                    except Exception as exc:
                        response = {'ok': False, 'error': str(exc), 'error_ui': local(str(exc))}
                    try:
                        conn.sendall((json.dumps(response, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode())
                    except OSError:
                        pass


def request(value):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as client:
        client.settimeout(25)
        client.connect(str(SOCKET))
        client.sendall((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode())
        data = b''
        while b'\n' not in data:
            part = client.recv(8192)
            if not part:
                break
            data += part
        return json.loads(data)


def ensure():
    CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    ALIVE.touch()
    try:
        request({'action': 'status'})
        return
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    with (CACHE / 'daemon.log').open('ab') as log:
        subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), 'daemon'],
                         stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log, start_new_session=True)
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            request({'action': 'status'})
            return
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise ValueError('語音服務未啟動，請查看 ~/.cache/oma-voice/daemon.log')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('action', choices=['daemon', 'ensure', 'status', 'replay', 'stop', 'auto', 'bind', 'send', 'test', 'engine', 'refresh', 'follow', 'language', 'source', 'pause'])
    parser.add_argument('value', nargs='?')
    parser.add_argument('--text')
    parser.add_argument('--full', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--json', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == 'language':
        if args.value not in LANGUAGES:
            raise ValueError(local('請選擇介面語言：')+' '.join(LANGUAGES))
        path = CHOICE
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = path.with_name(path.name + '.' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.tmp')
        temp.write_text(args.value)
        temp.chmod(0o600)
        temp.replace(path)
        try:
            request({'action': 'status'})
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
        return
    if args.action == 'daemon':
        serve()
        return
    ensure()
    if args.action == 'ensure':
        return
    result = request({'action': args.action, 'value': args.value or 'toggle',
                      'thread': args.value, 'text': args.text or '', 'full': args.full})
    result['request_id'] = uuid.uuid4().hex
    if result.get('ok') is not False and 'status' in result:
        result['status_ui'] = local(result['status'])
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False) if args.action == 'status' or args.json else
          result.get('error_ui') or local(result.get('status', '完成')))
    if result.get('ok') is False:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(local(str(error)), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

'''Edge TTS without API keys; local Piper/Sherpa fallback. Reads text on stdin.'''
import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from language import spoken

# The voice for each language a text can be spoken in: (Microsoft Edge online, espeak-ng offline).
SPEAKERS = {
    'en': ('en-US-AriaNeural', 'en-us'), 'zh': ('zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'cmn'), 'es': ('es-ES-ElviraNeural', 'es'),
    'de': ('de-DE-KatjaNeural', 'de'), 'fr': ('fr-FR-DeniseNeural', 'fr'), 'ja': ('ja-JP-NanamiNeural', 'ja'),
    'ko': ('ko-KR-SunHiNeural', 'ko'),
}

# Why online speech was skipped, shown beside the offline voice's name.
NOT_INSTALLED = '線上語音未安裝'
NO_MPG123 = '缺少 mpg123'
UNREACHABLE = '線上語音無回應'

def offline(text, output, reason=''):
    note = '（'+reason+'）' if reason else ''
    runtime = ROOT / 'tts/sherpa-onnx-v1.13.8-linux-aarch64-shared-cpu/bin/sherpa-onnx-offline-tts'
    model = ROOT / 'tts/vits-piper-zh_CN-huayan-medium'
    if spoken(text) == 'zh' and runtime.exists() and (model / 'zh_CN-huayan-medium.onnx').exists():
        Path(str(output)+'.backend').write_text('離線神經語音'+note)
        os.execv(str(runtime), [str(runtime), '--vits-model='+str(model/'zh_CN-huayan-medium.onnx'),
                 '--vits-tokens='+str(model/'tokens.txt'), '--vits-data-dir='+str(model/'espeak-ng-data'),
                 '--num-threads=2', '--output-filename='+str(output), '--', text])
    Path(str(output)+'.backend').write_text('離線基本語音'+note)
    os.execvp('espeak-ng', ['espeak-ng', '-v', SPEAKERS[spoken(text)][1], '-s', '175', '-w', str(output), '--', text])

def pieces(text, limit=1200):
    # One request per piece: a long reply in one request ran past the time limit and fell back to espeak-ng.
    parts, current = [], ''
    for sentence in re.findall(r'[^。！？!?；;\n]*[。！？!?；;\n]+|[^。！？!?；;\n]+', text):
        while len(sentence) > limit:
            parts.append(current+sentence[:limit-len(current)])
            sentence, current = sentence[limit-len(current):], ''
        if len(current)+len(sentence) > limit:
            parts.append(current)
            current = ''
        current += sentence
    return [part for part in parts+[current] if part.strip()]

async def fetch(edge_tts, text, voice):
    audio = b''
    async for chunk in edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice=voice, rate='-5%').stream():
        if chunk['type'] == 'audio':
            audio += chunk['data']
    if not audio:
        raise RuntimeError('no audio')
    return audio

async def online(text, output):
    import edge_tts
    if not shutil.which('mpg123'):
        raise FileNotFoundError('mpg123')
    mp3 = output.with_suffix('.mp3')
    try:
        voice = SPEAKERS[spoken(text)][0]
        with mp3.open('wb') as audio:
            for part in pieces(text):
                for attempt in range(3):
                    try:
                        audio.write(await asyncio.wait_for(fetch(edge_tts, part, voice), timeout=30))
                        break
                    except Exception:
                        # A dropped connection is common on a phone; espeak-ng is the last resort.
                        if attempt == 2:
                            raise
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        subprocess.run(['mpg123', '-q', '-w', str(output), str(mp3)], check=True, timeout=120)
        Path(str(output)+'.backend').write_text('自然語音（線上）')
    finally:
        mp3.unlink(missing_ok=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    output = Path(sys.argv[1])
    text = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not text:
        raise SystemExit('沒有可播放的文字')
    config = json.loads((Path.home()/'.config/omalauncher/voice.json').read_text())
    reason = ''
    if config.get('engine') != 'offline':
        try:
            asyncio.run(online(text, output))
            raise SystemExit(0)
        except Exception as error:
            reason = NOT_INSTALLED if isinstance(error, ImportError) else NO_MPG123 if isinstance(error, FileNotFoundError) else UNREACHABLE
            print('線上語音不可用，改用離線：'+type(error).__name__+' '+str(error)[:200], file=sys.stderr)
            output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    offline(text, output, reason)

import hmac
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

CACHE = Path.home() / '.cache/oma-speak'
CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
TOKEN = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
PORT = 18763
ORIGIN = f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}'
PAGE_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name('index.html')
LANG_PATH = Path.home() / '.config/omalauncher/voice-ui-language'
LANGUAGES = ('en', 'zh', 'es', 'de', 'fr', 'ja', 'ko')

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def reply(self, code, data, kind='text/plain; charset=utf-8'):
        data = data.encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', kind)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.send_header('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.headers.get('Host') != f'127.0.0.1:{PORT}':
            return self.reply(403, 'Invalid host')
        if self.path == '/language':
            value = LANG_PATH.read_text().strip() if LANG_PATH.exists() else ''
            return self.reply(200, value if value in LANGUAGES else LANGUAGES[0])
        if self.path == '/health':
            return self.reply(200, 'oma-speak-v1')
        if self.path != '/':
            return self.reply(404, 'Not found')
        self.reply(200, PAGE_PATH.read_text(), 'text/html; charset=utf-8')

    def do_POST(self):
        if (self.path not in ('/text', '/language') or self.headers.get('Origin') != ORIGIN
                or not hmac.compare_digest(self.headers.get('X-Speak-Token', ''), TOKEN)):
            return self.reply(403, 'Forbidden')
        try:
            size = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0'))
            if not 0 < size <= 65536:
                return self.reply(413, 'Text too long')
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(size))
            if self.path == '/language':
                value = body.get('language')
                if value not in LANGUAGES:
                    raise ValueError()
                LANG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                temp = LANG_PATH.with_name(LANG_PATH.name+'.tmp')
                temp.write_text(value)
                os.chmod(temp, 0o600)
                temp.replace(LANG_PATH)
                return self.reply(200, 'Language saved')
            text = body['text']
            if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) > 16000:
                raise ValueError()
            # Keep terminal escape/control sequences out of Bash insertion.
            text = ''.join(c for c in text if c >= ' ' and c != '\x7f').strip()
            tmp = CACHE / 'latest.tmp'
            tmp.write_text(text)
            os.chmod(tmp, 0o600)
            tmp.replace(CACHE / 'latest.txt')
            self.reply(200, 'Saved. Return to the launcher and tap Send to target.')
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, UnicodeError):
            self.reply(400, 'Invalid text')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', PORT), Handler)
    server.daemon_threads = True
    tokenfile = CACHE / 'token'
    tokenfile.write_text(TOKEN)
    os.chmod(tokenfile, 0o600)
    server.serve_forever()

widgets.author: amirinanto-r37
widgets.name: go limit
widgets.description: OpenCode Go usage per model: 5-hour, weekly and monthly ring gauges against that model's limits, credit left, cost sparkline. Estimated from the local opencode database.
commands:
db="$HOME/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db"
if [ ! -f "$db" ]; then printf '{"models":null,"hours":null}\n'; exit 0; fi
now=$(date +%s); h5ms=$((now*1000-18000000)); h24ms=$((now*1000-86400000))
dow=$(date +%u)
wk=$(date -d "$(date -d "@$((now - (dow-1)*86400))" +%F) 00:00" +%s)
mo=$(date -d "$(date +%Y-%m-01) 00:00" +%s); moMS=$((mo*1000)); wkMS=$((wk*1000))
earliest=$(( moMS < wkMS ? (moMS < h24ms ? moMS : h24ms) : (wkMS < h24ms ? wkMS : h24ms) ))
sel="json_valid(data)=1 and time_created >= $earliest and json_extract(data,'$.providerID')='opencode-go' and json_extract(data,'$.role')='assistant'"
q1="with cost as (select time_created as t, json_extract(data,'$.modelID') as m, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.input') as i, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.output')+json_extract(data,'$.tokens.reasoning') as o, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.read') as c, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.write') as v from message where $sel)
  select m as m,
    coalesce(sum(i) filter (where t >= $h5ms),0) as i5,
    coalesce(sum(o) filter (where t >= $h5ms),0) as o5,
    coalesce(sum(c) filter (where t >= $h5ms),0) as c5,
    coalesce(sum(v) filter (where t >= $h5ms),0) as v5,
    coalesce(sum(i) filter (where t >= $wkMS),0) as iw,
    coalesce(sum(o) filter (where t >= $wkMS),0) as ow,
    coalesce(sum(c) filter (where t >= $wkMS),0) as cw,
    coalesce(sum(v) filter (where t >= $wkMS),0) as vw,
    coalesce(sum(i) filter (where t >= $moMS),0) as im,
    coalesce(sum(o) filter (where t >= $moMS),0) as om,
    coalesce(sum(c) filter (where t >= $moMS),0) as cm,
    coalesce(sum(v) filter (where t >= $moMS),0) as vm,
    coalesce((min(t) filter (where t >= $h5ms))/1000,0) as f5
  from cost group by m order by m"
h=$(sqlite3 --json "$db" "
  with cost as (select time_created as t, json_extract(data,'$.modelID') as m, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.input') as i, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.output')+json_extract(data,'$.tokens.reasoning') as o, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.read') as c, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.write') as v from message where $sel),
  used as (select distinct m from cost),
  b(i,s) as (select 0, $h24ms union all select i+1, s+3600000 from b where i < 23)
  select used.m as m, b.i as hb,
    coalesce(sum(cost.i),0) as hs,
    coalesce(sum(cost.o),0) as hos,
    coalesce(sum(cost.c),0) as hcs,
    coalesce(sum(cost.v),0) as hvs
  from used cross join b
  left join cost on cost.m = used.m and cost.t >= b.s and cost.t < b.s + 3600000
  group by used.m, b.i order by used.m, b.i
" 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'if type == "array" then (group_by(.m) | map({m: .[0].m, hours: map([.hs, .hos, .hcs, .hvs])})) else null end')
[ -n "$h" ] || h=null
sqlite3 --json "$db" "$q1" 2>/dev/null | jq -c --argjson H "$h" '{models: (if type == "array" then . else null end), hours: $H}'

        if info.get("mime") not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png") or info.get("width", 0) < 640:
            continue
        if not 0.4 < info["width"] / max(info.get("height", 1), 1) < 3:
            continue
        try:
            with open(out + ".part", "wb") as f:
                f.write(get(info.get("thumburl") or info["url"], 30))
            with Image.open(out + ".part") as im:
                im = im.convert("RGBA")
                flat = Image.new("RGB", im.size, (255, 255, 255))  # transparency turns white, not black
                flat.paste(im, mask=im.getchannel("A"))
                flat.save(out, "JPEG", quality=85)
            os.remove(out + ".part")
        except Exception:
            continue
        meta = info.get("extmetadata", {})
        text = lambda k: re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub("<[^>]+>", "", unescape(meta.get(k, {}).get("value", "")))).strip()
        return {"title": page["title"].removeprefix("File:").rsplit(".", 1)[0],
                "artist": text("Artist")[:80] or "unknown", "license": text("LicenseShortName") or "see Commons",
                "url": info.get("descriptionurl", "")}
    return None


def credit_line(c):
    return f"{c['title']} · {c['artist']} · {c['license']} · Wikimedia Commons"


def picture(slide, path, x, y, w, h, whole=False, center=False):
    # Fills the box, cropping the overflow evenly (like CSS object-fit: cover). With whole, the
    # box shrinks to the picture's shape instead, so a diagram keeps its edges; center then
    # centres it across the box's width (otherwise it sits at the box's top left).
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        iw, ih = im.size
    box, img = w / h, iw / ih
    if whole:
        nw, nh = (w, int(w / img)) if img > box else (int(h * img), h)
        return slide.shapes.add_picture(path, x + ((w - nw) // 2 if center else 0), y, nw, nh)
    pic = slide.shapes.add_picture(path, x, y, w, h)
    if img > box:
        cut = (1 - box / img) / 2
        pic.crop_left = pic.crop_right = cut
    else:
        cut = (1 - img / box) / 2
        pic.crop_top = pic.crop_bottom = cut
    return pic


def rect(slide, x, y, w, h, color):
    s = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, x, y, w, h)
    s.fill.solid()
    s.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    s.line.fill.background()
    s.shadow.inherit = False
    return s


def textbox(slide, x, y, w, h, text, size, color=INK, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_right = 0
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    r = p.add_run()
    r.text = str(text)
    r.font.size = Pt(size)
    r.font.bold = bold
    r.font.color.rgb = color
    r.font.name = "Calibri"
    return tf


def bullets(tf, items, size, accent):
    # Fill a text frame with bullets; a list item that is itself a list holds sub-bullets.
    flat = []
    for it in items or []:
        if isinstance(it, list):
            flat += [(1, s) for s in it]
        else:
            flat.append((0, it))
    # Shrink text on crowded slides so it stays on the page.
    n = len(flat) + sum(len(str(s)) for _, s in flat) / 90
    size = size if n <= 7 else max(14, size - int((n - 7) * 1.2))
    first = True
    for level, s in flat:
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if first else tf.add_paragraph()
        first = False
        p.space_after = Pt(8 if level == 0 else 4)
        mark = p.add_run()
        mark.text = ("■  " if level == 0 else "◦  ")
        mark.font.size = Pt(size * (0.55 if level == 0 else 0.9))
        mark.font.color.rgb = accent if level == 0 else MUTED
        r = p.add_run()
        r.text = str(s)
        r.font.size = Pt(size if level == 0 else size - 3)
        r.font.color.rgb = INK if level == 0 else MUTED
        r.font.name = "Calibri"
        if level:
            p.level = 1


def frame(prs, title, accent, num, width=Inches(11.9)):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(0.45), width, Inches(1.0), title, 32 if width > Inches(8) else 28, accent, bold=True,
            anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE)
    textbox(slide, Inches(12.2), Inches(6.95), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.4), num, 11, MUTED, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    return slide


def cell_text(cell, text):
    # A table cell's text in one run (an empty cell has no run until one is added); returns its font.
    p = cell.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    for r in list(p.runs):
        p._p.remove(r._r)
    r = p.add_run()
    r.text = "" if text is None else str(text)
    return r.font


def notes(slide, text):
    if text:
        slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = str(text)


def fetch_all(spec, folder):
    # Fetches every picture the spec asks for, a few at a time. Returns {query: (path, credit)}.
    queries = [spec.get("image")] + [sl.get("image") for sl in spec.get("slides", [])]
    queries = list(dict.fromkeys(q for q in queries if isinstance(q, str) and q.strip()))

    def one(n_q):
        n, q = n_q
        path = os.path.join(folder, f"img{n}.jpg")
        c = fetch_image(q, path)
        return q, (path, c) if c else None

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(6) as pool:
        return {q: got for q, got in pool.map(one, enumerate(queries)) if got}


def render(spec, out):
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height = W, H
    accent = rgb(spec.get("theme"))
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ppt-img-")
    images = fetch_all(spec, folder)
    credits = []

    def img(q):
        got = images.get(q) if isinstance(q, str) else None
        if got and got[1] not in credits:
            credits.append(got[1])
        return got[0] if got else None

    # Title slide: a full accent background, with the deck's picture filling the right side.
    s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    rect(s, 0, 0, W, H, accent)
    cover = img(spec.get("image"))
    tw = Inches(6.6) if cover else Inches(11.5)
    if cover:
        picture(s, cover, Inches(7.5), 0, W - Inches(7.5), H)
    textbox(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(1.4), tw, Inches(2.6), spec.get("title", "Untitled"), 44 if cover else 46,
            PAPER, bold=True, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.BOTTOM)
    if spec.get("subtitle"):
        textbox(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(4.25), tw, Inches(1.8), spec["subtitle"], 20 if cover else 22, PAPER)

    for i, sl in enumerate(spec.get("slides", []), start=2):
        kind = sl.get("type", "bullets")
        title = sl.get("title", "")
        pic = img(sl.get("image"))
        if kind == "section":
            s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
            rect(s, 0, 0, W, H, TINT)
            tw = Inches(6.6) if pic else Inches(11.5)
            if pic:
                picture(s, pic, Inches(7.5), 0, W - Inches(7.5), H)
            textbox(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.4), tw, Inches(1.4), title, 40, accent, bold=True,
                    anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.BOTTOM)
            if sl.get("subtitle"):
                textbox(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(3.9), tw, Inches(1.2), sl["subtitle"], 20, MUTED)
        elif kind == "image":
            # A big picture with the title in a band above it and a caption below.
            s = frame(prs, title, accent, i)
            if pic:
                picture(s, pic, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.75), Inches(11.9), Inches(4.45), whole=True, center=True)
            elif sl.get("caption"):
                rect(s, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.75), Inches(11.9), Inches(4.45), TINT)
            if sl.get("caption"):
                textbox(s, Inches(0.7), Inches(6.3), Inches(11.4), Inches(0.6), sl["caption"], 15, MUTED)
        elif kind == "two_column":
            s = frame(prs, title, accent, i)
            cols = ((sl.get("left") or {}, 0.7), (sl.get("right") or {}, 6.95))
            for n, (col, x) in enumerate(cols):
                if pic and n == 1:
                    # The picture takes the right column's place; its heading goes on top of it.
                    picture(s, pic, Inches(x), Inches(1.9), Inches(5.7), Inches(4.85), whole=True)
                    continue
                rect(s, Inches(x), Inches(1.9), Inches(5.7), Inches(4.85), TINT)
                textbox(s, Inches(x + 0.3), Inches(2.05), Inches(5.1), Inches(0.6), col.get("heading", ""), 20,
                        accent, bold=True)
                tf = s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x + 0.3), Inches(2.75), Inches(5.1), Inches(3.9)).text_frame
                tf.word_wrap = True
                items = col.get("bullets") or []
                if pic:  # fold the right column into the left one
                    other = cols[1][0]
                    items = items + ([other["heading"]] if other.get("heading") else []) + \
                        ([other.get("bullets")] if other.get("bullets") else [])
                bullets(tf, items, 17, accent)
        elif kind == "table":
            s = frame(prs, title, accent, i)
            cols, rows = sl.get("columns") or [], sl.get("rows") or []
            if cols:
                h = min(Inches(4.9), Emu(Inches(0.5) * (len(rows) + 1)))
                t = s.shapes.add_table(len(rows) + 1, len(cols), Inches(0.7), Inches(1.9), Inches(11.9), h).table
                size = 16 if len(rows) <= 6 else 13
                for c, name in enumerate(cols):
                    cell = t.cell(0, c)
                    cell.fill.solid()
                    cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = accent
                    f = cell_text(cell, name)
                    f.bold, f.size, f.color.rgb = True, Pt(size), PAPER
                for r, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
                    for c in range(len(cols)):
                        cell = t.cell(r, c)
                        cell.fill.solid()
                        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = TINT if r % 2 else PAPER
                        f = cell_text(cell, row[c] if c < len(row) else "")
                        f.size, f.color.rgb = Pt(size), INK
        else:
            s = frame(prs, title, accent, i, Inches(7.0) if pic else Inches(11.9))
            if pic:
                # Text on the left, the picture on the right.
                picture(s, pic, Inches(8.0), Inches(1.9), Inches(4.6), Inches(4.85), whole=True)
                if kind == "summary":
                    rect(s, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.9), Inches(7.0), Inches(4.85), TINT)
                tf = s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.0 if kind == "summary" else 0.7), Inches(2.05),
                                          Inches(6.6 if kind == "summary" else 7.0), Inches(4.6)).text_frame
                tf.word_wrap = True
                bullets(tf, sl.get("bullets"), 20, accent)
            else:
                if kind == "summary":
                    rect(s, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.9), Inches(11.9), Inches(4.85), TINT)
                tf = s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.0 if kind == "summary" else 0.7), Inches(2.05),
                                          Inches(11.3), Inches(4.6)).text_frame
                tf.word_wrap = True
                bullets(tf, sl.get("bullets"), 22, accent)
        notes(s, sl.get("notes"))

    if credits:
        s = frame(prs, "Image credits", accent, len(prs.slides) + 1)
        tf = s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.7), Inches(1.8), Inches(11.9), Inches(5.0)).text_frame
        tf.word_wrap = True
        for n, c in enumerate(credits):
            p = tf.paragraphs[0] if n == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
            p.space_after = Pt(6)
            r = p.add_run()
            r.text = credit_line(c)
            r.font.size = Pt(12 if len(credits) <= 12 else 10)
            r.font.color.rgb = MUTED
            r.font.name = "Calibri"

    prs.save(out)
    shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)
    return len(prs.slides)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1] == "--image":
        query, out = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
        c = fetch_image(query, out)
        if not c:
            print(f"no usable picture for: {query}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        with open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), "credits.txt"), "a") as f:
            f.write(credit_line(c) + "\n")
        with Image.open(out) as im:
            print(f"{out}: {im.size[0]}x{im.size[1]} · {c['title']} ({c['license']})")
        sys.exit(0)
    with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
        print(render(json.load(f), sys.argv[2]))

def atomic_json(path, value):

def clean_text(text):
    # Spoken notes are in the language of the reply, or the wrong voice would be picked for it.
    notes = SPOKEN[spoken(text)]
    text = re.sub(r'```.*?```', notes[2], text, flags=re.S)
    text = re.sub(r'!?\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)', r'\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', notes[3], text)
    text = re.sub(r'(?m)^\s*(?:#{1,6}\s+|[-*+]\s+|\d+[.)]\s+|>\s*)', '', text)

def summarize(text, limit=360):
    '''Extract sentences verbatim; retain an explicit failure/limitation if present.'''
    text = clean_text(text)
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in re.split(r'(?<=[。！？.!?])\s*|\n+', text) if s.strip()]
    selected = []
    important = re.compile(r'未完成|尚未|無法|不能|失敗|限制|需要你|待.*確認|未.*驗證|未.*測試|not tested|failed|unable|cannot|limitation', re.I)
    warning = next((s for s in sentences if important.search(s)), '')
    # Reserve room for a caveat even when it appears at the end of a long answer.
    budget = limit - min(len(warning), limit // 2) - (8 if warning else 0)
    used = 0
    for s in sentences:
        if s == warning:
            continue
        if used + len(s) > budget:
            if not selected:
                selected.append(s[:budget].rstrip() + '…')
            break
        selected.append(s)
        used += len(s) + 1
    if warning:
        selected.append(warning[:limit // 2])
    notes = SPOKEN[spoken(text)]
    return notes[0] + ' '.join(selected) + notes[1]

    if event.get('type') != 'event_msg':

    payload = event.get('payload', {})

    text = payload.get('last_agent_message')

    return payload.get('turn_id') or payload.get('root_turn_id') or event.get('timestamp'), text

        self.last_turn = None
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        # The tiles show these; 'status' and 'error' stay as written, for the next change of language.
        language = chosen()
        self.language_at = changed_at()
        self.state['status_ui'] = local(self.state.get('status', ''), language)
        self.state['error_ui'] = local(self.state.get('error', ''), language)
        for old in ('status_en', 'error_en', 'checked_at'):
            self.state.pop(old, None)
        stamp = self.state.get('reply_at')
        if isinstance(stamp, str):
            try:
                self.state['reply_at'] = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(stamp.replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp()
            except ValueError:
                self.state['reply_at'] = None
        self.state.update(auto=self.config['auto'], mode=self.config['mode'], thread=self.config['thread'], engine=self.config['engine'], follow_latest=self.config['follow_latest'], source=self.config['source'], pause_minutes=self.config['pause_minutes'], source_name=self.state.get('source_name','Codex'))
        # The tiles redraw on every write, so write only what changed.
        if self.state != self.saved:
            atomic_json(CACHE / 'state.json', self.state)
            self.saved = dict(self.state)

    def bind(self, thread):
        path = find_session(thread)
        if path is None:
            raise ValueError('找不到指定會話')
        self.config['thread'] = str(uuid.UUID(thread))
        self.path = path
        # Seed replay, but never automatically speak historical answers on startup.
        self.pending = b''
        self.last_turn = None
        self.state.update(full='', summary='', last_turn='', reply_at=None, awaiting=False, status='已連接，等待回覆')
        with path.open('rb') as f:
            for line in f:
                try:
                    event = json.loads(line)
                    reply = completed_reply(event)
                    kind = event.get('payload', {}).get('type')
                    if kind == 'task_started':
                        self.state['awaiting'] = True
                    elif kind in ('task_complete', 'turn_aborted'):
                        self.state['awaiting'] = False
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if reply:
                    self.last_turn, full = reply
                    self.state.update(full=full, summary=summarize(full), last_turn=self.last_turn, reply_at=event.get('timestamp'))
            self.offset = f.tell()
        self.state['status'] = 'Codex 正在回覆…' if self.state['awaiting'] else ('已同步最近回覆' if self.state['full'] else '已連接，等待回覆')
        atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
        self.save()

    def poll(self):
        if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
            return self.poll_terminal()
        if not self.config['thread']:
            self.config['thread'] = latest_session()
        if time.monotonic() - self.checked_session >= RETRY:
            self.checked_session = time.monotonic()
            if self.config['follow_latest']:
                thread = latest_session()
                if thread != self.config['thread']:
                    self.stop()
                    self.bind(thread)
        if self.path is None:
            self.bind(self.config['thread'])
        size = self.path.stat().st_size
        if size == self.offset:
            return
        if size < self.offset:
            self.bind(self.config['thread'])
        with self.path.open('rb') as f:
            f.seek(self.offset)
            data = f.read(4 * 1024 * 1024)
            self.offset = f.tell()
        lines = (self.pending + data).split(b'\n')
        self.pending = lines.pop()
        for line in lines:
            try:
                event = json.loads(line)
                reply = completed_reply(event)
                kind = event.get('payload', {}).get('type')
                if kind == 'task_started':
                    self.state.update(awaiting=True, status='Codex 正在回覆…', error='')
                    self.save()
                elif kind in ('task_complete', 'turn_aborted'):
                    self.state['awaiting'] = False
            except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
                continue
            if not reply or reply[0] == self.last_turn:
                continue
            self.last_turn, full = reply
            self.state.update(full=full, summary=summarize(full), last_turn=self.last_turn,
                              status='收到新回覆', error='', awaiting=False, reply_at=event.get('timestamp'))
            self.save()
            if self.config['auto']:
                self.play(self.state[self.config['mode']])

    def poll_terminal(self):
        if time.monotonic() < self.next_terminal:
            return
        self.next_terminal = time.monotonic() + 3
        try:
            pane, label, full = terminal_snapshot()
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.next_terminal = time.monotonic() + RETRY
            self.state.update(source_name='Terminal', term_pane='', status=str(exc),
                              full='', summary='', error='', reply_at=None, awaiting=False)
            self.save()
            return
        self.state.update(source_name=label, term_pane=pane, status='已連接終端 · 點播放讀取畫面',
                          error='', awaiting=False)
        if full != self.term_last:
            self.term_last = full
            self.state.update(full=full, summary=clean_text(full)[-360:], reply_at=time.time() if full else None)
        self.save()

    def idle(self):
        '''Nothing is being spoken, and no tile, command or Codex activity for the chosen time.'''
        limit = self.config['pause_minutes'] * 60
        if not limit or self.state.get('playing'):
            return False
        # Codex still writing its log counts, so a long task is read aloud with the screen off.
        seen = [ALIVE] + ([self.path] if self.path and self.config['source'] == 'codex' else [])
        try:
            return time.time() - max(path.stat().st_mtime for path in seen) >= limit
        except OSError:
            return False

    def stop(self):
        with self.player_lock:
            self.generation += 1
            if self.process is not None:
                self.process.terminate()
                try:
                    self.process.wait(timeout=2)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    self.process.kill()
                    self.process.wait()
                self.process = None
            self.state.update(playing=False, status='已停止')
            self.save()

    def play(self, text):
        if not text.strip():
            raise ValueError('還沒有可播放的回覆')
        self.stop()
        with self.player_lock:
            generation = self.generation
            self.state.update(playing=True, status='正在播放', error='')
            self.save()

        def worker():
            wav = CACHE / ('speech-' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.wav')
            try:
                with self.player_lock:
                    if generation != self.generation:
                        return
                if not shutil.which('espeak-ng') or not shutil.which('paplay'):
                    raise ValueError('需要 espeak-ng 和 paplay')
                commands = [
                    ([str(Path(__file__).parent / 'venv/bin/python'),
                      str(Path(__file__).parent / 'synthesize.py'), str(wav)], clean_text(text).encode()),
                    (['paplay', str(wav)], None),
                ]
                for args, data in commands:
                    if data is None:
                        with self.player_lock:
                            if generation == self.generation:
                                backend = Path(str(wav) + '.backend')
                                self.state['status'] = '正在播放 · ' + (backend.read_text() if backend.exists() else '語音')
                                self.save()
                    with self.player_lock:
                        if generation != self.generation:
                            return
                        proc = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE if data else subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
                        self.process = proc
                    try:
                        _, err = proc.communicate(data, timeout=300)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        proc.kill()
                        proc.communicate()
                        raise ValueError('播放逾時')
                    if proc.returncode and generation == self.generation:
                        raise ValueError(err.decode(errors='replace')[-400:] or '播放失敗')
                with self.player_lock:
                    if generation == self.generation:
                        self.process = None
                        # Keep the reason on screen when the natural voice was not the one heard.
                        used = Path(str(wav) + '.backend')
                        used = used.read_text() if used.exists() else ''
                        self.state.update(playing=False, status='播放完成 · '+used if '離線' in used and '（' in used else '播放完成')
                        self.save()
            except Exception as exc:
                with self.player_lock:
                    if generation == self.generation:
                        self.state.update(playing=False, status='播放失敗', error=str(exc))
                        self.save()
            finally:
                wav.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                Path(str(wav) + '.backend').unlink(missing_ok=True)
        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    def command(self, request):
        action = request.get('action')
        if action != 'status':
            self.retry_at = 0
        if action in ('replay', 'send'):
            if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
                self.next_terminal = 0
            self.poll()
        if action == 'status':
            # Also how a change of interface language reaches the tiles: save() writes only what changed.
            self.save()
            return self.state
        if action == 'replay':
            self.play(self.state.get('full' if request.get('full') else 'summary', ''))
        elif action == 'test':
            self.play(SPOKEN[chosen()][4])
        elif action == 'stop':
            self.stop()
        elif action == 'auto':
            value = request.get('value', 'toggle')
            self.config['auto'] = not self.config['auto'] if value == 'toggle' else value == 'on'
            if not self.config['auto']:
                self.stop()
            self.state['status'] = '自動播報已開啟' if self.config['auto'] else '自動播報已關閉'
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.save()
        elif action == 'engine':
            value = request.get('value', 'toggle')
            if value == 'toggle':
                value = 'offline' if self.config['engine'] == 'online' else 'online'
            if value not in ('online', 'offline'):
                raise ValueError('請選 online 或 offline')
            self.stop()
            self.config['engine'] = value
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.state['status'] = '已切換線上自然語音' if value == 'online' else '已切換離線神經語音'
            self.save()
        elif action == 'pause':
            value = str(request.get('value', 'toggle')).strip().lower()
            if value == 'toggle':
                value = '0' if self.config['pause_minutes'] else str(PAUSE_MINUTES)
            if value == 'off':
                value = '0'
            if not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit() or int(value) > 1440:
                raise ValueError('請輸入 1 到 1440 的分鐘數，或 off')
            self.config['pause_minutes'] = int(value)
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.state['status'] = '已更新閒置暫停時間' if int(value) else '閒置後不再暫停'
            self.save()
        elif action == 'refresh':
            self.stop()
            if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
                self.next_terminal = 0
                self.poll_terminal()
            else:
                self.bind(latest_session() if self.config['follow_latest'] else self.config['thread'])
        elif action == 'source':
            value = request.get('value')
            if value not in ('codex', 'terminal'):
                raise ValueError('請選 Codex 或 Terminal')
            self.stop()
            self.config['source'] = value
            self.state.update(full='', summary='', reply_at=None, source_name='Codex' if value == 'codex' else 'Terminal')
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            if value == 'terminal':
                self.next_terminal = 0
                self.term_last = None
                self.poll_terminal()
            else:
                self.bind(latest_session() if self.config['follow_latest'] else self.config['thread'])
        elif action == 'follow':
            self.config['follow_latest'] = not self.config['follow_latest']
            if self.config['follow_latest']:
                self.stop()
                self.bind(latest_session())
            atomic_json(CONFIG, self.config)
            self.save()
        elif action == 'bind':
            self.stop()
            self.config['follow_latest'] = False
            self.bind(request['thread'])
        elif action == 'send':
            text = request.get('text', '').strip()
            if not text or len(text) > 16000:
                raise ValueError('請先輸入內容（最多 16000 字）')
            if any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in '\n\t' for c in text):
                raise ValueError('文字含有控制字元')
            self.stop()
            if self.config['source'] == 'terminal':
                pane, label, _ = terminal_snapshot()
                terminal_send(pane, text)
                self.state.update(status='已送到終端 · '+label, error='')
            else:
                result = subprocess.run(['codex', 'queue', '--thread', self.config['thread'], '--message', text],
                                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
                if result.returncode:
                    raise ValueError(result.stderr[-500:] or result.stdout[-500:] or '送出失敗')
                self.state.update(status='已送到這個 Codex 會話的佇列', error='')
            self.save()
        else:
            raise ValueError('未知命令')
        return {'ok': True, 'status': self.state['status']}


def serve():
    CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    with (CACHE / 'daemon.lock').open('w') as lock:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            return
        ALIVE.touch()
        reader = Reader()
        if reader.config['source'] == 'terminal':
            reader.poll_terminal()
        elif reader.config['thread']:
            reader.bind(reader.config['thread'])
        SOCKET.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as server:
            server.bind(str(SOCKET))
            SOCKET.chmod(0o600)
            server.listen(4)
            while not reader.idle():
                # The dictation page and the setup screen write the language without telling the service.
                if changed_at() != reader.language_at:
                    reader.save()
                if time.monotonic() >= reader.retry_at:
                    try:
                        reader.poll()
                    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
                        reader.state.update(status='等待會話記錄', error=str(exc))
                        reader.save()
                        reader.retry_at = time.monotonic() + RETRY
                if not select.select([server], [], [], 0.5)[0]:
                    continue
                conn, _ = server.accept()
                with conn:
                    conn.settimeout(5)
                    try:
                        data = b''
                        while b'\n' not in data and len(data) <= 70000:
                            part = conn.recv(8192)
                            if not part:
                                break
                            data += part
                        if len(data) > 70000:
                            raise ValueError('請求太大')
                        response = reader.command(json.loads(data))
                    except Exception as exc:
                        response = {'ok': False, 'error': str(exc), 'error_ui': local(str(exc))}
                    try:
                        conn.sendall((json.dumps(response, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode())
                    except OSError:
                        pass


def request(value):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as client:
        client.settimeout(25)
        client.connect(str(SOCKET))
        client.sendall((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode())
        data = b''
        while b'\n' not in data:
            part = client.recv(8192)
            if not part:
                break
            data += part
        return json.loads(data)


def ensure():
    CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    ALIVE.touch()
    try:
        request({'action': 'status'})
        return
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    with (CACHE / 'daemon.log').open('ab') as log:
        subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), 'daemon'],
                         stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log, start_new_session=True)
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            request({'action': 'status'})
            return
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise ValueError('語音服務未啟動，請查看 ~/.cache/oma-voice/daemon.log')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('action', choices=['daemon', 'ensure', 'status', 'replay', 'stop', 'auto', 'bind', 'send', 'test', 'engine', 'refresh', 'follow', 'language', 'source', 'pause'])
    parser.add_argument('value', nargs='?')
    parser.add_argument('--text')
    parser.add_argument('--full', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--json', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == 'language':
        if args.value not in LANGUAGES:
            raise ValueError(local('請選擇介面語言：')+' '.join(LANGUAGES))
        path = CHOICE
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = path.with_name(path.name + '.' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.tmp')
        temp.write_text(args.value)
        temp.chmod(0o600)
        temp.replace(path)
        try:
            request({'action': 'status'})
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
        return
    if args.action == 'daemon':
        serve()
        return
    ensure()
    if args.action == 'ensure':
        return
    result = request({'action': args.action, 'value': args.value or 'toggle',
                      'thread': args.value, 'text': args.text or '', 'full': args.full})
    result['request_id'] = uuid.uuid4().hex
    if result.get('ok') is not False and 'status' in result:
        result['status_ui'] = local(result['status'])
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False) if args.action == 'status' or args.json else
          result.get('error_ui') or local(result.get('status', '完成')))
    if result.get('ok') is False:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(local(str(error)), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

'''Edge TTS without API keys; local Piper/Sherpa fallback. Reads text on stdin.'''
import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from language import spoken

# The voice for each language a text can be spoken in: (Microsoft Edge online, espeak-ng offline).
SPEAKERS = {
    'en': ('en-US-AriaNeural', 'en-us'), 'zh': ('zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural', 'cmn'), 'es': ('es-ES-ElviraNeural', 'es'),
    'de': ('de-DE-KatjaNeural', 'de'), 'fr': ('fr-FR-DeniseNeural', 'fr'), 'ja': ('ja-JP-NanamiNeural', 'ja'),
    'ko': ('ko-KR-SunHiNeural', 'ko'),
}

# Why online speech was skipped, shown beside the offline voice's name.
NOT_INSTALLED = '線上語音未安裝'
NO_MPG123 = '缺少 mpg123'
UNREACHABLE = '線上語音無回應'

def offline(text, output, reason=''):
    note = '（'+reason+'）' if reason else ''
    runtime = ROOT / 'tts/sherpa-onnx-v1.13.8-linux-aarch64-shared-cpu/bin/sherpa-onnx-offline-tts'
    model = ROOT / 'tts/vits-piper-zh_CN-huayan-medium'
    if spoken(text) == 'zh' and runtime.exists() and (model / 'zh_CN-huayan-medium.onnx').exists():
        Path(str(output)+'.backend').write_text('離線神經語音'+note)
        os.execv(str(runtime), [str(runtime), '--vits-model='+str(model/'zh_CN-huayan-medium.onnx'),
                 '--vits-tokens='+str(model/'tokens.txt'), '--vits-data-dir='+str(model/'espeak-ng-data'),
                 '--num-threads=2', '--output-filename='+str(output), '--', text])
    Path(str(output)+'.backend').write_text('離線基本語音'+note)
    os.execvp('espeak-ng', ['espeak-ng', '-v', SPEAKERS[spoken(text)][1], '-s', '175', '-w', str(output), '--', text])

def pieces(text, limit=1200):
    # One request per piece: a long reply in one request ran past the time limit and fell back to espeak-ng.
    parts, current = [], ''
    for sentence in re.findall(r'[^。！？!?；;\n]*[。！？!?；;\n]+|[^。！？!?；;\n]+', text):
        while len(sentence) > limit:
            parts.append(current+sentence[:limit-len(current)])
            sentence, current = sentence[limit-len(current):], ''
        if len(current)+len(sentence) > limit:
            parts.append(current)
            current = ''
        current += sentence
    return [part for part in parts+[current] if part.strip()]

async def fetch(edge_tts, text, voice):
    audio = b''
    async for chunk in edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice=voice, rate='-5%').stream():
        if chunk['type'] == 'audio':
            audio += chunk['data']
    if not audio:
        raise RuntimeError('no audio')
    return audio

async def online(text, output):
    import edge_tts
    if not shutil.which('mpg123'):
        raise FileNotFoundError('mpg123')
    mp3 = output.with_suffix('.mp3')
    try:
        voice = SPEAKERS[spoken(text)][0]
        with mp3.open('wb') as audio:
            for part in pieces(text):
                for attempt in range(3):
                    try:
                        audio.write(await asyncio.wait_for(fetch(edge_tts, part, voice), timeout=30))
                        break
                    except Exception:
                        # A dropped connection is common on a phone; espeak-ng is the last resort.
                        if attempt == 2:
                            raise
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        subprocess.run(['mpg123', '-q', '-w', str(output), str(mp3)], check=True, timeout=120)
        Path(str(output)+'.backend').write_text('自然語音（線上）')
    finally:
        mp3.unlink(missing_ok=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    output = Path(sys.argv[1])
    text = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not text:
        raise SystemExit('沒有可播放的文字')
    config = json.loads((Path.home()/'.config/omalauncher/voice.json').read_text())
    reason = ''
    if config.get('engine') != 'offline':
        try:
            asyncio.run(online(text, output))
            raise SystemExit(0)
        except Exception as error:
            reason = NOT_INSTALLED if isinstance(error, ImportError) else NO_MPG123 if isinstance(error, FileNotFoundError) else UNREACHABLE
            print('線上語音不可用，改用離線：'+type(error).__name__+' '+str(error)[:200], file=sys.stderr)
            output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    offline(text, output, reason)
